description: Synthetic rough interview notes for question extraction.

input.notes: Panel of two. First asked about a failed release, so I used the incident story and mentioned the 38 minute recovery. They pushed on what I would change; I said earlier customer messaging. Second asked how I coach leads. I gave the new lead example and the weekly review. No questions on cloud cost. They also asked how I measure whether a weekly review is working. I said I look at whether decisions are written down, whether the same blocker returns and whether the team lead can run the review without me. I gave the example of the new lead who took over the agenda after six weeks. I forgot to mention the shared checklist until the follow-up. The final question was about a time I missed a commitment. I used the first migration date and explained the two hidden consumers we found during discovery. I said I told the customer before the date passed, moved the commitment once and added a dependency check to the next plan. They asked what I would do first next time; I said map the consumers before setting the date. One interviewer pushed on the difference between influencing a decision and owning it. I used the roadmap reset to show where I owned the cut and where I only recommended the sequence. The other interviewer asked how I handled the customer who disagreed; I described the two options I offered and the evidence I used to settle the choice.
